designationHistory.indexText: Valley City Wetland Management District About Us What We Do Facility Services Laws & Regulations Contact Us Visit Us Activities Rules & Policies Get Involved News Map About Us Image Details Established in 1971, Valley City Wetland Management District manages both Service-owned waterfowl production areas as well as wetland and grassland easements on private lands located in Barnes, Cass, Griggs, St
